svg.title: RRF: the documents both retrievers found win
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “RRF: the documents both retrievers found win” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A hand-drawn whiteboard with three ranked columns. DENSE lists A B C D E and BM25 lists F C G A H, each entry annotated longhand with its reciprocal rank score from one over sixty-one downward. A and C, which appear in both lists, are ringed in amber and joined by curved arrows, and in the fused third column they rise to the top at .0320 each, above F at .0164 which was first in one list. An inset shows why the constant sixty flattens the gap between ranks one and two from 1.00-versus-0.50 to .0164-versus-.0161, two crossed-out score distributions show dense cosine and BM25 are not on the same scale, and a marginal-gain curve flattens after two retrievers at NDCG .790.
